items.title: Devfest Port Harcourt 2026
items.text:
Date: 28 November 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 28 November 2026, 15:30 UTC
Location: Port Harcourt, Port Harcourt
Registration: Free registration

Join us for the Devfest Port Harcourt 2026, where dynamic minds unite to ignite innovation and inspire change! This event brings together developers, tech enthusiasts, and industry experts for an enriching experience filled with insightful talks and networking opportunities. Dive into workshops and sessions tailored to elevate your skills and fuel your projects. Be part of a community that challenges boundaries and creates impactful solutions. Don't miss this chance to connect and collaborate with fellow tech innovators. Mark your calendar and RSVP now to secure your spot!
